gui.itemexplorer.title: Item Explorer
message.itemexplorer.storage_locked: Storage data could not be loaded safely. Transfers are disabled; original data is preserved. Ask the server owner to check the log and recovery backup.
gui.itemexplorer.choose_target: Click a destination folder or breadcrumb. Esc cancels.
gui.itemexplorer.withdraw_hint: Take the entered quantity. Right-click an item for 1, or Shift-click for 64.
gui.itemexplorer.move_hint: Move the entered quantity to a folder. You can also drag an item onto a folder.
gui.itemexplorer.all_hint: Set the quantity to the selected entry's full amount.
gui.itemexplorer.deposit_hint: Deposit the carried stack. Shift-click an inventory stack to deposit directly.
message.itemexplorer.full: Storage full or nothing to deposit
message.itemexplorer.inventory_full: Inventory full or quantity is zero
message.itemexplorer.invalid_name: Use 1–24 characters; no slashes or control characters
message.itemexplorer.duplicate_name: A folder with this name already exists
message.itemexplorer.root_folder: Cannot rename or delete the main drive
message.itemexplorer.not_empty: Only empty folders can be deleted
message.itemexplorer.folder_limit: This drive reached its folder limit or 8-level depth limit.
message.itemexplorer.entry_limit: This drive reached its item entry limit.
message.itemexplorer.nested_device: Terminals, NAS devices and disks cannot be stored in a drive.
message.itemexplorer.item_too_large: This item's extra data is too large
message.itemexplorer.missing_item: Item moved or removed. Select again.
gui.itemexplorer.install_hint: Carry a disk and click Insert, or Shift-click a disk in your inventory.
gui.itemexplorer.eject_hint: Eject to your inventory. Requires one empty slot.
gui.itemexplorer.nas_hint: Behind terminal to connect | Shift-click to insert
disk.itemexplorer.blank: Initialized on first insertion. Choose your own name and use.
disk.itemexplorer.portable: Data belongs to this world. Portable within the same save.
message.itemexplorer.disk_missing: Disk data is missing. Check the original world and backups.
message.itemexplorer.disk_mismatch: Disk tier does not match world data. Mount refused.
message.itemexplorer.disk_conflict: This disk is already mounted in another bay.
message.itemexplorer.disk_offline: Disk offline. Reinsert it or choose another drive.
message.itemexplorer.disk_only: A bay accepts one storage disk.
message.itemexplorer.nas_full: All four bays are occupied. Eject a disk first.
message.itemexplorer.cross_disk: To move between drives, take items into your inventory first.
